mod.description: Makes zombies work faster at workbenches and in the garden (up to 10x) and optionally gives them extra mastery.
Enabled.name: Mod enabled
Enabled.description: Turns the mod on or off (takes effect immediately).
SpeedMultiplier.name: Work speed
SpeedMultiplier.description: How fast zombies work at workbenches and in the garden (1.0 = normal, up to 10x).
SpeedMultiplier.hint: How fast zombies work at workbenches and in the garden (1.0 = normal, max. 10.0).
MasteryBonus.name: Mastery bonus (levels)
MasteryBonus.description: Extra mastery levels for working zombies (0 = normal). This is not a multiplier. Higher mastery lets them make recipes above their level and gives more progress per hit (mastery ÷ recipe level, the game allows at most 3 cells per hit).
MasteryBonus.hint: Extra mastery levels for working zombies (0 = normal). Max. 3 cells per hit.
